# Transporeon: Freight Audit SelfService API (FASS)

- **Product:** Transporeon: Freight Audit SelfService API (FASS) (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** OAuth 2.0 client credentials from Trimble Transportation identity (id.trimble-transportation.com). Declared security schemes: OAuth2.
- **Access:** Shippers using Transporeon Freight Audit.
- **To call it you would need:** a Trimble Transportation client-credentials application for eu1.api.trimble.com/transportation/financials/v1.
- **Documented servers:** `https://eu1.api.trimble.com/transportation/financials/v1`.
- **Definition:** [transporeon/inline-api-for-freight-audit-selfservice](https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/211386426/API+for+Freight+Audit+SelfService) (Freight Audit SelfService API, version 1.7.0). Documentation: https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/211386426/API+for+Freight+Audit+SelfService.
